noeuds.role: Plays one of the object's animations, at the chosen speed (frames per second), looping or once. If it is already playing, it continues without restarting.
noeuds.exemple: the “walk” animation when the character moves.

noeuds.role: Stops the animation and goes back to its first frame.
Pauses the animation on the current frame.
noeuds.exemple: freeze the character during a pause.

noeuds.role: Resumes the animation where it was paused.
Changes the animation speed (frames per second) without restarting it.
